program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # diff pair L (large area -> low flicker)
    "itail": (14e-6, 8e-6, 18e-6),
    "i2":    (22e-6, 12e-6, 28e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmidp": (13.0, 8.0, 15.5),      # PMOS mirror / M6 / replica gm/Id (must match)
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidn": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # NMOS current sources gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.5),
    "cc":    (2.0e-12, 1.0e-12, 3.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),        # multiplier on p2-cancelling Rz
    "kr":    (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),        # replica ratio I2/Ir
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it, i2 = p["itail"], p["i2"]
    ir = i2 / p["kr"]
    gp, Lp, gn, Ln = p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], p["gmidn"], p["Ln"]

    # ---- PMOS mirror family (M3 diode reference; M4, M6, Mr copies at same density)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, it / 2, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, it / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    vsg = m3.vgs
    m4 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, it / 2, vds=vsg)
    m6 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, i2, vds=vsg)
    mr = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, ir, vds=vsg)
    vd3 = vdd - vsg

    # ---- differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.5)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=max(vd3 - vtail, 0.15), vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)

    # ---- NMOS bias: ibias diode -> tail ; replica diode -> output sink
    mb = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, iref, vds=0.7)
    mb = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, it, vds=mb.vgs)
    mrn = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, ir, vds=0.7)
    mrn = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, ir, vds=mrn.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, i2, vds=mrn.vgs)

    # ---- compensation
    cc = p["cc"]
    C1 = m6.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + m4.cgd
    CLt = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    den = C1 * cc + C1 * CLt + cc * CLt
    rz = p["rzk"] * (1.0 / m6.gm + den / (m6.gm * cc * cc))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d3", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)       # diode side: inverting terminal
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)       # output side: non-inverting terminal
    n.dev("M3", "d3", "d3", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d3", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("MR", "rn", "d3", "vdd", "vdd", mr)          # replica of M6
    n.dev("MRN", "rn", "rn", "vss", "vss", mrn)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "rn", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "xz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "xz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / den / (2 * PI)
    dz = cc * (rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * dz) if dz > 0 else 1e12
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m1.cdd))
    deg = 180 / PI
    pm = (90 - math.atan(ugbw / p2) * deg + math.atan(ugbw / z) * deg
          - math.atan(ugbw / p3) * deg - 0.5 * math.atan(ugbw / pmir) * deg)

    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cl + cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2 + ir)

    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 16.0 / 3 * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    Kn, Kp, f = 1e-9, 3e-10, 1e3
    fl = 2 * Kn / (m1.W * m1.L * f) + 2 * Kp / (m3.W * m3.L * f) * (m3.gm / gm1) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(th + fl)

    psrr = gain_db + 25          # replica tracking cancels M6 gds modulation
    cmrr = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / max(m5.gds, 1e-12))

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise, "psrr_db": psrr, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "vos": 0.5e-3}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS) with replica-biased NMOS output sink
